feature_policy.shared_physics: physical/state carrier plus frozen local first/second ordered differences and norms
feature_policy.object: DLO2/DLO3 identity and fixed low-order interactions
feature_policy.backend: include only when more than one source backend is explicitly present
feature_policy.sensor: omit unless an explicit non-physical sensor-calibration carrier exists; never derive it from residual targets

failure_policy: Publish the source diagnosis whether positive, negative, or mixed. A failed source gate forbids DLO4/DLO5 opening under this protocol version.
